caption: The drawing depicts a detailed section of wrought iron or cast iron railing with intricate ornamental patterns. The design includes three vertical segments, each featuring an arch at the top with symmetrical, curling elements and leaf-like motifs. The central part of each segment has a large, downward-facing, stylized leaf and a curved form resembling a fern or palm frond. The rail is rendered primarily in dark shades of black and gray, conveying the metallic nature of the material, and the background is a solid, light beige or off-white color. The composition is horizontal, with the railing section extending across the lower part of the image, leaving ample blank space above and around it. The artist's signature, "Pearl Torell," is located in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Fence
